$about: This repo's site in the ecosystem's shared form - rendered by the CORE's tools/docsite.mjs (one form, many sites, zero copied generators). This repository carries no generator: the core's pages workflow clones it and runs the generator with this directory as the working directory, so everything below is the whole of what a stack decides about its own site.
$layout: ADR-031 in the core: one domain, surface first. This stack takes the node prefix - site_root for the landing, base_path for the docs. Those two lines are the entire difference between being served at the root and being served under a prefix; nothing else in the generator is layout-aware.
